summary: Iteration 2 covers the new Gallery page, For Sale (BMW Z4 GT3 V8) page, Lightbox, POA pricing, Home For Sale spotlight, updated Navbar (8 links), plus regression on Chat + Contact + backend. Backend pytest suite extended with a Z4/£68,000 chat test — 9/9 pass. Frontend Playwright verified: all 8 routes render with 0 broken /vad/ images; Gallery filters work (All=39, Forged Wheels=11, BMW Z4=12) and Lightbox opens/navigates (counter 1/39 → 2/39)/closes correctly; For Sale shows title 'BMW Z4 GT3 V8 STREET', price '£68,000', 20 gallery items, both Enquire buttons navigate to /contact; Wheels shows 6 POA labels; Programmes Z4 modal shows POA + 'View 1-of-1 For Sale' button that navigates to /for-sale, while non-Z4 modal correctly hides that button; Home spotlight shows £68,000 and View Listing routes to /for-sale; Chat streams and answers with £68,000 within ~3s; Contact form submits and shows success.
critical_code_review_comments: Prior iteration_1 review items still stand (in-memory chat_sessions won't survive restarts; no rate limiting on /api/chat and /api/enquiries; consider EmailStr for EnquiryCreate.email; chat error fallback returns HTTP 200 making programmatic error detection hard).

carForSale.gallery references /vad/z4/z4-profile.jpg, z4-rear-wing.jpg, z4-gen2-wing.jpg, z4-diffuser-exhaust.jpg, z4-vented-bonnet.jpg, z4-closeup.jpg, z4-tow-strap.jpg, z4-full.jpg — all present on disk and returned 200 during navigation, no broken image detected.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_Playwright enquiry created via Contact form; one TEST_John enquiry via pytest; a few TEST_ chat sessions created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py has 9 tests including test_chat_mentions_z4_price which validates the assistant knows the £68,000 listing. Frontend selectors validated: gallery-filters, gallery-filter-{slug} (slugs: all, gt-programmes, forged-wheels, carbon-aero, bmw-z4-gt3-v8), gallery-item, lightbox, lightbox-image, lightbox-close, lightbox-prev, lightbox-next, forsale-title, forsale-price, forsale-gallery-item, forsale-enquire-hero, forsale-enquire-cta, chat-toggle-button, chat-input, chat-send-button, chat-messages, contact-name-input, contact-email-input, contact-message-textarea, contact-submit-button, contact-success-message. Use sessionStorage.setItem('vad_intro_done','1') to skip intro splash.
